notFound.title: This page is missing
notFound.desc: The page you're looking for may have been moved, deleted, or the link is incorrect. Let's start over from the home page.

unauthorized.title: Please sign in first
unauthorized.desc: This page is only available to signed-in users. We'll bring you back to where you were after signing in.

forbidden.title: You don't have access
forbidden.desc: Your account doesn't have permission to view this page. If this seems wrong, contact an administrator to grant access.

badGateway.title: Connection interrupted
badGateway.desc: The gateway could not get a valid response from the upstream server. This is usually temporary — please try again shortly.

serviceUnavailable.title: Service under maintenance
serviceUnavailable.desc: The server is being upgraded or maintained and can't handle requests right now. Please check back in a moment.

gatewayTimeout.title: The request timed out
gatewayTimeout.desc: The server did not respond in time. Please try again later, or check your network connection.

error.footnote: If this keeps happening, try again later or contact the site administrator.
